title: Paros Wedding Venues and How to Get Married There
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: NEW guide (not a refresh). Title 'Paros Wedding Venues and How to Get Married There' has NO venue count: list however many qualify (aim 8 to 10, no padding). Model: content/posts/mykonos-wedding-venues. Every venue verified by a live read of its own official site saying it hosts weddings (never snippets alone); house rules not published written as 'Not published', listed on a booking checklist; no prices or fees.

OVERLAP: SEO checks whether any site page ranks for 'paros wedding venues' and variants (paros wedding, getting married in paros, wedding in paros, paros chapel wedding, antiparos wedding). Link the Greece venues guide, Greece packages guide and Mykonos venues guide (/destination-weddings/mykonos-wedding-venues) (drafts), the Greece hub, /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions once.

AUTHORITY RULE (content-system/brand/voice-guide.md 'Write with authority'): no research talk in the copy (what we could or couldn't find, trace or confirm; our sources or method; what the internet says; myths sections; 'you will often read'). Customs without a strong source are written as living practice in a confident voice ('Many couples...'), never with a meaning or origin stated as fact. 'Often told' at most once per post, never 'it is often told that'. No hedge stacking: cite a source once by link; date legal and travel facts once per section. Source gaps go in the run report only. No per-line source credits (never 'Britannica describes', 'the museum holds', 'the study records'). No myth-busting lines ('you will often read', 'confident dates').

Venue areas: Naoussa and the north; Parikia and the west; inland villages (Lefkes, Marpissa); east and south coast (Golden Beach, Drios); Antiparos only as a short nearby note if venues there qualify. Mix of boutique and luxury hotels, estates and wineries, villas, event venues. Each entry: setting, ceremony options as stated, capacity, rooms, exclusive use where published else 'Not published', one standout. One Advisor line in the whole body (comparison section) plus the close.

HOW TO GET MARRIED THERE is a main section, official sources only: civil, Greek Orthodox and symbolic ceremonies as official sources state them; the civil ceremony at the Municipality of Paros (Dimos Parou) with steps, documents and lead times only if an official municipal page can be read live, else 'check with the municipality and the embassy, including any fees'; Australian steps (certificate of no impediment and notarial services at the Australian Embassy Athens; Smartraveller getting married overseas and recognition in Australia), dated 'as at November 2026'; link the Greece guide's legal section. Nothing implies the Advisor handles legal, church or religious paperwork.

Other sections: intro; Key takeaways (exactly 4 one-sentence); at-a-glance table (5 columns); how to compare like for like; choosing an area; venues by area; getting there (Paros airport and ferries, official sources only); when to marry (HNMS data only if for Paros or a clearly labelled nearby station, else Smartraveller heat and wildfire); FAQ; close.

Sources: venues' official sites, Municipality of Paros official site, visitgreece.gr, airport official site, hnms.gr, Smartraveller, the Australian Embassy Athens. Never competitor wedding sites, directories, planner blogs, booking sites, review sites or Wikipedia.

Speed: Apify web-fetch and DataForSEO. 4 parallel batches (A: Naoussa and north, fact_01+; B: Parikia, west and inland villages, fact_100+; C: east and south coast plus Antiparos, fact_200+; D: legal, airport, ferries, weather, fact_300+), 15 min HARD by the clock, no new reads after the limit, save after every 3 facts, scratch folders par_a..par_d; top-up par_e (fact_400+) only if fewer than 8 venues qualify; never retry a declined call.
Images: placeholders only; every venue image licensed or from a venue press kit with permission; never AI for a venue, destination or wedding; competitor images reference-only.
Headings must not contain pasted keywords in brackets.

Do not use 'from first idea to the last dance' or 'last dance'; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; nothing on legal, church or religious paperwork; no transfer arrangements; no Wedded Privileges.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices or amounts; venue names allowed, no other vendor names; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
